name: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.description: Write references manually as <Picture N>, <Video N> or <Audio N>. Pictures and videos each count occupied slots from 1 in slot order. Audio counts enabled video soundtracks first in video-slot order, then occupied standalone audio slots. Clearing an earlier slot or changing soundtrack inclusion can renumber later references. Slot labels are not prompt numbers. Prompts are never rewritten.
